scores.notes: Both show a round stone-block pit with lions and a wooden gate, but the left is night (dark navy sky, torchlight) while the right is broad daylight in an open desert with palms; neither description asks for that change.
Peter in the courtyard (left foreground) and stepping from the boat (right) both have curly dark-to-greying hair, a grey-streaked full beard, the same weathered middle-aged face and build.
Both show a wooden fishing boat with a mast and hanging lamp on a dark, wave-tossed lake at night with a hilly shoreline; the place is consistent.
Storm (left) then calm (right) is asked for; both show the same lake with a hilly shoreline and wooden mast boats, so the place matches apart from the requested change.
Daniel, small in the pit on the left and large at the feast on the right, has short grey hair, a short grey beard, a lean older face and the same blue robe.
Both show a dry sandy seabed between towering green-blue water walls under dark clouds, with desert banks and palms; the layout is compatible.
Daniel at the feast (left) and in the den (right) has short grey hair, a short grey beard and a lean older face, in the same blue robe.
Calm (left) after storm (right) is asked for; both show the same lake with hilly shores and a lakeside village, and wooden mast boats.
Both show a pebbly lakeshore with a beach fire, a fishing boat, hills across the water and low stone houses along the shore in pale morning light.
Both show a night storm on the lake with moonlight, a wooden mast boat with a lamp, and a hilly shoreline with houses on the left.
Daniel in the pit (left) and at the feast (right) has short grey hair, a short grey beard and a lean older face, both in a blue robe.
Daniel at the feast (left) has grey hair and a grey beard with lighter skin, while Daniel in the den (right) has dark hair, a dark short beard, noticeably darker skin and looks younger.
Peter by the brazier (left) and lifting the lame man (right) both have dark curly hair, a grey-streaked beard and a similar middle-aged face.
Moses by the pig (left) and striking the rock (right) both have long white hair, a long white beard and an elderly face.
David kneeling at the anointing (left) and dodging the spear (right) is a beardless youth with short dark curly hair and a slight build in both.
Both show a dry seabed between tall green water walls at night under dark clouds, with sandy, rocky banks; the place is compatible.

Both are at night under storm clouds, with a churning sea or water walls beside a sandy path, rocky banks and palm trees along the shore. The banks are arranged compatibly, allowing for the different viewpoints.
